cases.subject: AX4102: welcome, schedule and course materials
cases.body: Welcome to AX4102 Applied AI Systems. Classes run Thursdays 18:30–21:30 in Studio B. The handbook, Topic 1 slides and team-project brief are now available. Bring a laptop for the in-class lab.

expected.action: Review the handbook, Topic 1 slides, and team-project brief before class

cases.subject: AX4102 team project: proposal requirements
cases.body: Submit a two-page proposal for the AX4102 team project. Include the problem, intended users, data plan, success metrics, risks, and team responsibilities. Upload one PDF per team by 23:59 on 4 October 2026.

expected.action: Submit the AX4102 two-page team proposal as one PDF

cases.subject: AX4102 proposal deadline extended and rubric clarified
cases.body: The AX4102 proposal deadline is extended from 4 October to 6 October 2026 at 18:00. The PDF may be up to three pages excluding references. The rubric weights reasoning 40%, evaluation design 30%, feasibility 20%, and presentation 10%.

expected.action: Update the AX4102 proposal to the clarified rubric and submit by the extended deadline

cases.subject: Submission received: AX4102 team proposal
cases.body: Your team submission AX4102-Team-Orbit-Proposal.pdf was received at 17:41 on 6 October 2026. Confirmation ID AX4-7K2M. No further action is required unless the teaching team contacts you.

cases.subject: Project NOVA kickoff and ownership
cases.body: Project NOVA will prototype an email-triage assistant for student teams. Alex owns retrieval and citations; Sam owns the interface; Priya owns evaluation. The first checkpoint is 29 September at 15:00.

expected.action: Prepare the Project NOVA retrieval and citation checkpoint update

cases.subject: Project NOVA: scope decision and demo scenario
cases.body: Decision from today's NOVA review: support Gmail, Outlook and forwarded university mail in the demo. Use 20 synthetic messages. Do not build calendar write-back this sprint. The main demo question will ask what remains for the AX4102 proposal.

expected.decision: Use three mailbox sources and 20 synthetic messages; defer calendar write-back

cases.subject: Project NOVA evaluation review: three gaps
cases.body: The NOVA evaluation review found three gaps: irrelevant retrieval sources for identifier queries, duplicate actions after reprocessing, and subscription emails appearing in the action list. Please add regression cases before the final demo.

expected.action: Add regression tests for retrieval precision, action idempotency, and subscription exclusion

cases.subject: Project NOVA final demo requirements
cases.body: Final NOVA demos are on 9 October 2026. Submit a public repository, a 5–8 minute video with presenter and screen visible, a report of no more than 1,200 words, and transparent data and eval files. Repository materials are due by 12:00 on 8 October.

expected.action: Submit the NOVA repository, demo video, report, data, and eval documentation

cases.subject: New sign-in to your demo account — SEC-4821
cases.body: A sign-in from Chrome on macOS in Singapore was recorded at 07:02. Reference SEC-4821. If this was you, no action is needed. If not, review account activity and change your password from the official account page.

expected.conditional_action: Review SEC-4821 only if the sign-in is unfamiliar

cases.subject: URGENT: mailbox suspension — verify within 30 minutes
cases.body: Your mailbox will be deleted unless you confirm your password and payment card at http://account-verify.invalid/login immediately. Reply with your one-time code if the page does not load.

cases.subject: CloudNotes Pro renewal on 15 October
cases.body: CloudNotes Pro renews on 15 October 2026 for USD 12 per month. No action is required to continue. You may change or cancel the plan before renewal from account settings.

cases.subject: CloudNotes Pro now includes meeting summaries
cases.body: Your existing CloudNotes Pro plan now includes automatic meeting summaries and calendar sync at no additional charge. The monthly price and renewal date are unchanged.

cases.subject: CloudNotes payment failed — update by 18 October
cases.body: We could not renew CloudNotes Pro using the saved payment method. Service becomes read-only after 18 October 2026. Update payment details from the official account settings page if you want to keep Pro.

expected.action: Update the CloudNotes payment method or allow the plan to become read-only

cases.subject: Helio Robotics graduate engineering talk
cases.body: Helio Robotics will present its 2027 graduate engineering programme on 12 October 2026 from 16:00–17:00 in Career Studio 2. Registration is optional and closes 10 October.

cases.subject: Helio Robotics applications close 20 October
cases.body: Applications for Helio Robotics graduate software and AI roles close at 23:59 on 20 October 2026. Submit a CV, transcript, and a 200-word project summary through the careers portal.

cases.subject: Invitation: Responsible AI roundtable
cases.body: You are invited to the Responsible AI roundtable on 14 October 2026, 14:00–16:00, at Harbour Room 3. Please reply by 9 October if you plan to attend.

expected.action: Reply whether you will attend the Responsible AI roundtable

cases.subject: Venue changed: Responsible AI roundtable
cases.body: The Responsible AI roundtable remains on 14 October from 14:00–16:00 but has moved from Harbour Room 3 to Gallery Hall 1. Existing registrations remain valid.

cases.subject: Case CS-1047 resolved: repository access restored
cases.body: Case CS-1047 is resolved. Access to the Project NOVA repository has been restored for Alex and Sam. Please reopen the case within three business days only if access still fails.

cases.subject: Agent Systems Weekly: evaluation patterns
cases.body: This week's editorial covers retrieval evaluation, citation faithfulness, and synthetic test data. It is an informational newsletter with no deadline or required response.

cases.subject: Coffee after Thursday's AX4102 class?
cases.body: Would you like to get coffee after AX4102 this Thursday? No urgency—reply whenever convenient. This is a personal invitation, not a course announcement.
